pages.title: Welcome to Netplay!
pages.description: Host on one device, then choose Join on the other. Both devices should have the same game.

pages.title: Ad Hoc or WiFi?
pages.description: Ad hoc networks usually provide better performance than WiFi. Option only shows on supported devices.

pages.title: WiFi Power Saving
pages.description: You can also choose to disable WiFi power saving, which may improve performance. On some devices this requires a driver reboot of several seconds. Turns off on reboot.

pages.title: Compatibility cores
pages.description: Use Netplay's matched cores when the installed cores differ between devices?

pages.title: Ready to play
pages.description: Choose Host or Join in the main menu. You can change this answer later in Configuration > Settings.
